value: One remembered branch leads to Mor Grayhoof. He survived the fall into Lower Blackrock Spire, but trolls captured him and War Master Voone tortured him. The spectral assassins finished what the fall had not. Mor’s story is one of the manual’s haunted loci; it is an alternative account of a former companion’s fate, not an assertion that every adventurer fought every spirit in this order.
editorNote: Research status: the accessible quest and manual pages reproduce in-game evidence but are secondary mirrors. The manual is Bodley’s perspective. Alternate class/faction targets are editorially ordered and are not one canonical adventurer’s route.
